name: nooks
description: Design a custom brick set with Nooks: real bricks, checked structure, revisions, a manual and a parts list.

interface.longDescription: Connect your agent to a Nooks build. Build with real parts, check the structure in software, keep every save as a revision, and export a manual, a parts list and a BrickLink wanted list. You can edit the same build by hand in the browser workbench.
defaultPrompt: Design a custom brick set from a photo I attach and check the structure.
Open my latest build, check it and export the instructions.

positive.prompt: Build a small red tower on a 4x4 base, part by part, and check it.
positive.tools_triggered: runtime_guide, list_builds, create_build, find_parts, read_project, build_program, check_model
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the runtime guide, creates one build, places only parts that find_parts returned, and reports the check_model result, including any rule it fails.

positive.prompt: Design a custom brick set from this photo and check it.
positive.tools_triggered: runtime_guide, record_source, find_parts, read_project, build_program, check_model
positive.expected_behavior: Records the actual photo and original words, derives visible requirements and dependent questions, builds with connectors, checks the saved revision and compares source-matched and other views. Iterates on the largest mismatch; incomplete source comparison stays unverified.

positive.description: Open and check an existing build
positive.prompt: Open my latest build, check it and tell me what fails.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the most recent build, reads its current revision, and reports the rules check_model fails together with the parts each rule names.

positive.description: Export instructions and a parts list
positive.prompt: Export the instructions and the parts list for this build.
positive.expected_behavior: Passes the same saved revision to finalize_model and export_kit, then returns the manual, parts list and BrickLink wanted list and reports any incomplete checks or unverified parts.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest saved version of this build.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved revision's render with an Exact PNG link and the link that opens the build in the workbench.

positive.prompt: Build a Brain Flakes chair from this photo, preserving its open lattice and thin rails.
positive.tools_triggered: runtime_guide, create_build, record_source, read_project, run_code, check_model, inspect_build, view
positive.expected_behavior: Chooses brainflakes-standard; records the image; preserves disc scale and negative space without a brick minimum; checks legal joins, compares multiple saved views and avoids unavailable brick export and physics tools.

positive.prompt: Continue improving the reference match while keeping my hand edits.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the current baseRevision. On conflict or timeout, reads again before retrying. Preserves the human edit and compares the updated saved geometry with the original source.

positive.prompt: The source photo or visual reviewer is unavailable; report what you can verify.
positive.expected_behavior: Separates geometry validity from unavailable source comparison. Does not invent image observations or a pass, repeatedly save unchanged geometry, or substitute an illustration for the saved render.

negative.description: Asking for prices or stock. The plugin has no live price or stock data, so it declines to estimate either and points to the seller instead.
negative.prompt: How much will these parts cost, and are they in stock?

negative.description: Does not publish a private build merely to get a preview. Public sharing requires the user to request it; an explicit request is already sufficient authorization.
negative.prompt: Improve this chair and show me a preview.

negative.description: Asking to skip the check. The agent does not call a model buildable unless check_model passes, and it says a pass is a software check, not a test of physical buildability.
negative.prompt: Just tell me it's buildable, skip the check.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Exports link to a BrickLink wanted list that the person takes to a seller.

publication.release_notes: Strengthen reference-led design, separate validity/alignment/quality, add Brain Flakes routing and preserve human edits. Includes the Nooks best-practices guide and a review record.
